name: Mang Den pig
summary: Măng Đen’s free-range hill pig, small enough to roast whole over charcoal with củ nén, sawtooth herb, lemongrass, and chili until the skin is golden and crisp. The meat is fragrant and firm, and Sedang cooks also grill black pig on skewers with chili salt and forest leaves.
origin: The heo rẫy of the Măng Đen plateau, in Kon Plông.
taste: Fragrant and firm, because the pigs range and eat wild feed. Sedang black pig is firm and sweet.
howToEat: The whole pig, the largest adult under 20 kg, is seasoned with củ nén, sawtooth herb, coriander root, lemongrass, and chili and roasted over charcoal. Sedang skewers come with chili salt and forest leaves.
seoTitle: Mang Den pig — whole roast and skewers
seoDescription: Măng Đen hill pig roasted whole over charcoal until the skin is crisp, and Sedang black pig on skewers with chili salt.
priceBand: Skewers 250,000–400,000 VND a plate (Go Vietnam, Măng Đen)
